capabilities: Upload images pasted from the clipboard to LskyPro
Batch-upload all local images in the current note or the whole vault and replace links
Download internet images to local storage
Accept multiple files via drag and drop
Configure LskyPro domain, token, and storage policy
extras: Users must install and configure their own LskyPro instance first; the README notes a restart of Obsidian is needed after updating the plugin.
problem: Obsidian saves pasted images as local vault files, which grows the vault and makes notes hard to share, so users want images hosted on an external image bed.
summary: Image uploader that sends pasted, dropped, or local images to a LskyPro image bed and replaces note links with the uploaded URLs.
